skeleton: request to plan to tender to bids to evaluation to report to signed contract to alerts, dashboard and audit trail

steps.title: 1. the requester describes the need to the assistant and submits the request
2. procurement submits the drafted plan; the delegate approves and locks it
3. procurement builds the tender pack; the delegate gives permission; procurement publishes
4. two suppliers register, submit sealed bids, and the tender closes
5. procurement opens the evaluation; evaluators declare and score; the chair locks consensus
6. procurement generates the report; the delegate approves it
7. legal drafts the contract from the approved report and releases it; the delegate signs and it locks
8. the contract manager sees the signed contract with its record and scheduled alerts
9. the executive sees the procurement on the dashboard with its completion ticks
10. probity finds every stage of the journey in the audit trail
